songs.title: No Men In No Man's Land
Beneath a Sea of Stars Part 1

tags.name: Lore
tags.notes: The backdrop imagery was a nod to October 31, 2014's Chilling, Thrilling Sounds of the Haunted House Halloween set, with the haunted house reappearing and opening up to reveal the band playing within its walls.

tags.name: Lore
tags.notes: The backdrop became blue sky and fluffy clouds above a mountainous terrain; following the pause, the images became fractalized and began to move.

tags.name: Lore
tags.notes: The backdrop became an 80's-style video game called "Tube Raider," appearing to be played in the night sky over Las Vegas. At the end of the song, the screen displayed "Game Over" along with video game avatars of the band.

tags.name: Banter
tags.transcript: TREY: Thanks everybody, we'll be right back. Thank you.

tags.name: Jamcharts
tags.notes: A swift pivot from the standard towards upbeat, blissful play opens the portal before shifting towards introspective melodic minor key territory. Page's dominating presence via both electric piano and wobbly synths then coaxes the jam towards psychedelia, as Fishman's tribalistic rhythms grow a bit more complex, gradually coalescing into a thick psychedelic groove-fest. After the 13:00 mark, the music puddles into an almost hellishly dense/atonal soundscape, eventually forming up into a driving attack before once again oscillating back towards soundscape-y madness. One last push for a full band groove eventually fades back into "Light's" chorus to end.

tags.name: Lore
tags.notes: The backdrop showed a lakeshore in front of a mountain range, with lighted, moving sculptures reflecting off the water's surface.

tags.name: Lore
tags.notes: The backdrop changed to a lush valley with a waterfall centered behind the band.

tags.name: Lore
tags.notes: The backdrop returned to focus on the lighted sculptures from Mike's Song.

tags.name: Lore
tags.notes: The backdrop was a dark forest at night, populated by animals with glowing eyes, as well as glowing fish swimming through the trees, and eventually glowing pink jellyfish which rose into the sky during the jam segment. Eventually the view returned to the forest, where peacocks displayed glowing tails amid numerous fish, until the entire perspective was swallowed by a whale.

tags.name: Banter
tags.transcript: TREY: Thanks so much everybody, we'll see you tomorrow night. Be safe. Thank you.
